This file fits exploratory LBA models for Exp 2: bias (A varies by response),
t0 (non-decision time varies by condition), and full (both). Results are
compared against the preregistered model at the end.

<!-- Note: original exploratory models were fit with incorrect "Famous"/"Novel" -->
<!-- condition labels. These scripts use the correct "Learned"/"Novel" labels -->
<!-- from the clean data pipeline. -->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

pkgs <- c(
  "EMC2", "tidyverse", "here"
  )
vapply(
  pkgs, library, logical(1), character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE
  )
```

# 1. Data

```{r}
#| label: wrangle

data_emc <- read_csv(here("exp_2", "data", "data_exp_2.csv")) |>
  select(pid, cond, keypress, rt) |>
  rename(subjects = pid, S = cond, R = keypress) |>
  mutate(
    subjects = factor(subjects),
    S        = factor(S, levels = c("Novel", "Learned")),
    R        = if_else(R == "q", "Learned", "Novel"),
    R        = factor(R, levels = c("Novel", "Learned"))
  ) |>
  as.data.frame()
```

# 2. Shared settings

```{r}
#| label: shared-settings

matchfun <- function(d) d$S == d$lR

v_mean <- c(
  "v_SNovel:lMFALSE"   = 0, "v_SLearned:lMFALSE" = 0,
  "v_SNovel:lMTRUE"    = 1, "v_SLearned:lMTRUE"  = 1,
  sv_lMTRUE            = log(.5)
)
v_sd <- c(
  "v_SNovel:lMFALSE"   = 2, "v_SLearned:lMFALSE" = 2,
  "v_SNovel:lMTRUE"    = 2, "v_SLearned:lMTRUE"  = 2,
  sv_lMTRUE            = .5
)
```

# 3. Bias model

```{r}
#| label: design-bias

design_bias <- design(
  data      = data_emc,
  model     = LBA,
  matchfun  = matchfun,
  formula   = list(v ~ 0 + S:lM, sv ~ 0 + lM, B ~ 0 + lR, A ~ 0 + lR, t0 ~ 1),
  constants = c(sv_lMFALSE = log(1))
)

mu_mean_bias <- c(v_mean,
  B_lRNovel   = log(1), B_lRLearned = log(1),
  A_lRNovel   = log(.5), A_lRLearned = log(.5),
  t0          = log(.3)
)
mu_sd_bias <- c(v_sd,
  B_lRNovel   = .5, B_lRLearned = .5,
  A_lRNovel   = .3, A_lRLearned = .3,
  t0          = .3
)

prior_bias <- prior(design_bias, type = "standard",
                    mu_mean = mu_mean_bias, mu_sd = mu_sd_bias)
plot(x = prior_bias)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-bias
#| eval: false

LBA_exp2_bias <- make_emc(data_emc, design_bias,
                           type = "standard", prior = prior_bias)
LBA_exp2_bias <- fit(LBA_exp2_bias,
  cores_per_chain = 3,
  fileName        = here("exp_2", "models", "tmp.RData"),
  iter            = 10000,
  step_size       = 500
)
save(LBA_exp2_bias, file = here("exp_2", "models", "LBA_exp2_bias.RData"))
```

```{r}
#| label: check-bias

load(here("exp_2", "models", "LBA_exp2_bias.RData"))
check(LBA_exp2_bias)
plot_pars(LBA_exp2_bias, selection = "mu", layout = c(2, 5))
```

```{r}
#| label: pp-bias
#| eval: false

pp_bias <- predict(LBA_exp2_bias, n_cores = 10)
save(pp_bias, file = here("exp_2", "models", "pp_LBA_exp2_bias.RData"))
```

```{r}
load(here("exp_2", "models", "pp_LBA_exp2_bias.RData"))
plot_fit(data_emc, pp_bias, factors = "S", layout = c(2, 3))
```

# 4. T0 model

```{r}
#| label: design-t0

design_t0 <- design(
  data      = data_emc,
  model     = LBA,
  matchfun  = matchfun,
  formula   = list(v ~ 0 + S:lM, sv ~ 0 + lM, B ~ 0 + lR, A ~ 1, t0 ~ 0 + S),
  constants = c(sv_lMFALSE = log(1))
)

mu_mean_t0 <- c(v_mean,
  B_lRNovel    = log(1), B_lRLearned  = log(1),
  A            = log(.5),
  t0_SNovel    = log(.3), t0_SLearned = log(.3)
)
mu_sd_t0 <- c(v_sd,
  B_lRNovel    = .5, B_lRLearned  = .5,
  A            = .3,
  t0_SNovel    = .3, t0_SLearned  = .3
)

prior_t0 <- prior(design_t0, type = "standard",
                  mu_mean = mu_mean_t0, mu_sd = mu_sd_t0)
plot(x = prior_t0)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-t0
#| eval: false

LBA_exp2_t0 <- make_emc(data_emc, design_t0,
                         type = "standard", prior = prior_t0)
LBA_exp2_t0 <- fit(LBA_exp2_t0,
  cores_per_chain = 3,
  fileName        = here("exp_2", "models", "tmp.RData"),
  iter            = 10000,
  step_size       = 500
)
save(LBA_exp2_t0, file = here("exp_2", "models", "LBA_exp2_t0.RData"))
```

```{r}
#| label: check-t0

load(here("exp_2", "models", "LBA_exp2_t0.RData"))
check(LBA_exp2_t0)
plot_pars(LBA_exp2_t0, selection = "mu", layout = c(2, 5))
```

```{r}
#| label: pp-t0
#| eval: false

pp_t0 <- predict(LBA_exp2_t0, n_cores = 10)
save(pp_t0, file = here("exp_2", "models", "pp_LBA_exp2_t0.RData"))
```

```{r}
load(here("exp_2", "models", "pp_LBA_exp2_t0.RData"))
plot_fit(data_emc, pp_t0, factors = "S", layout = c(2, 3))
```

# 5. Full model

```{r}
#| label: design-full

design_full <- design(
  data      = data_emc,
  model     = LBA,
  matchfun  = matchfun,
  formula   = list(v ~ 0 + S:lM, sv ~ 0 + lM, B ~ 0 + lR, A ~ 0 + lR, t0 ~ 0 + S),
  constants = c(sv_lMFALSE = log(1))
)

mu_mean_full <- c(v_mean,
  B_lRNovel    = log(1), B_lRLearned  = log(1),
  A_lRNovel    = log(.5), A_lRLearned = log(.5),
  t0_SNovel    = log(.3), t0_SLearned = log(.3)
)
mu_sd_full <- c(v_sd,
  B_lRNovel    = .5, B_lRLearned  = .5,
  A_lRNovel    = .3, A_lRLearned  = .3,
  t0_SNovel    = .3, t0_SLearned  = .3
)

prior_full <- prior(design_full, type = "standard",
                    mu_mean = mu_mean_full, mu_sd = mu_sd_full)
plot(x = prior_full)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-full
#| eval: false

LBA_exp2_full <- make_emc(data_emc, design_full,
                           type = "standard", prior = prior_full)
LBA_exp2_full <- fit(LBA_exp2_full,
  cores_per_chain = 3,
  fileName        = here("exp_2", "models", "tmp.RData"),
  iter            = 10000,
  step_size       = 500
)
save(LBA_exp2_full, file = here("exp_2", "models", "LBA_exp2_full.RData"))
```

```{r}
#| label: check-full

load(here("exp_2", "models", "LBA_exp2_full.RData"))
check(LBA_exp2_full)
plot_pars(LBA_exp2_full, selection = "mu", layout = c(2, 5))
```

```{r}
#| label: pp-full
#| eval: false

pp_full <- predict(LBA_exp2_full, n_cores = 10)
save(pp_full, file = here("exp_2", "models", "pp_LBA_exp2_full.RData"))
```

```{r}
load(here("exp_2", "models", "pp_LBA_exp2_full.RData"))
plot_fit(data_emc, pp_full, factors = "S", layout = c(2, 3))
```

# 6. Model comparison

```{r}
#| label: model-comparison

load(here("exp_2", "models", "LBA_exp2_v1.RData"))
load(here("exp_2", "models", "LBA_exp2_bias.RData"))
load(here("exp_2", "models", "LBA_exp2_t0.RData"))
load(here("exp_2", "models", "LBA_exp2_full.RData"))

compare(
  list(
    preregistered = LBA_exp2_v1,
    bias          = LBA_exp2_bias,
    t0            = LBA_exp2_t0,
    full          = LBA_exp2_full
  ),
  cores_per_prop = 2
)
```
